evals.name: default-flat-listing
evals.expected_output: Flat reverse-chronological list of up to 10 most recent insights in natural-language format. Each row: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM — <summary> — *<folder definition>*'. Must use folder DEFINITIONS (italic), not raw folder names. Ends with a drill-down prompt. Should NOT include Today/Yesterday headers (no time hint given).

evals.name: time-grouped-yesterday
evals.prompt: What did we work on yesterday and today?
evals.expected_output: Time-grouped output with '## Today' and '## Yesterday' headers (always shown; 'No new entries today/yesterday.' if empty). Reverse-chrono within each group. Folder definitions in italics, not raw folder names. No L0-L4 codes or fragmentation jargon. Ends with drill-down prompt.

evals.name: technical-query-root-index
evals.prompt: Show me ROOT_INDEX and the tag dictionary.
evals.expected_output: Technical mode. Raw ROOT_INDEX.md content (folder names, counts, last update, tags). Verbatim active-tags table from _global_tags.md. No drill-down prompt at the end (this is a registry dump, not a listing).
